svg.title: DiscreteGarageState: from garage to records
svg.desc: Left: Pecos map with AGV 4 at C10, tray 15 with a payload at P3, and bay 7. Right: the matching records inside one DiscreteGarageState snapshot.

g.text: Start from a resource on the map (AGV, tray, payload, bay).

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Follow its number to the record on the right.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: AGV and tray records both point back to a graph node through GaragePose.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: All records live in one DiscreteGarageState snapshot.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: GaragePose{node_id, heading} is a graph node plus a discrete heading in degrees (90 = west), not an x/y position in

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: metres. The map coordinates come from the layout, not from the state.

g.text: Each numbered resource on the map becomes one record inside the single DiscreteGarageState snapshot the planner replays events against. Values are illustrative.
